retry.title: RetryingInvoiceWriter.Write
retry.narration: The first attempt saves an invoice, but the acknowledgement is lost. The retry loop does not know the commit succeeded. It allocates a new invoice ID and saves the same invoice again. The executed check expected one invoice and found two. Requirement INV one oh five says retries must not duplicate an invoice. Reusing a stable invoice identity is a possible repair. The proposed-fix toggle illustrates that behavior; the current pull request still creates a new identity on every attempt.

quiz.question: The store committed the invoice, but its acknowledgement was lost. What does the current retry create?

options.label: One invoice, because a timeout rolls back the commit
A second invoice with a new ID
No invoice, because the retry is cancelled

quiz.explanation: The first invoice is already stored. A new ID on retry creates a second record. The executed lost-acknowledgement check observed two invoices instead of one.
